subject.title: Feature Request: User-Level Skill Preferences/Conventions Support

question: Should OpenClaw officially support a per-user, per-skill markdown sidecar such as `preferences.md`, and what precedence and refresh semantics should it have?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing skill loading and prompt/context contract, and current main has no maintainer-selected sidecar model to implement mechanically.

options.title: Adopt `preferences.md` sidecar
options.body: Standardize a markdown sidecar next to user skills, load it only with the triggered skill, and cover precedence plus prompt refresh in docs and tests.

options.title: Keep manual user conventions
options.body: Leave `conventions.md` as an unofficial file that agents may read manually, avoiding a new framework-level skill contract.

options.title: Fold into broader skill settings
options.body: Defer this until maintainers decide the related skill priority and allowlist-composition issues as one skill personalization model.

recommendation.title: Adopt `preferences.md` sidecar
recommendation.body: Standardize a markdown sidecar next to user skills, load it only with the triggered skill, and cover precedence plus prompt refresh in docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current blame/history signal across the loader, prompt contract, and published skills docs, and are also repeatedly routed in the issue timeline.
